Typography

tokens.css · --font-size-* · text-display … text-label

One scale for every page. Headings step down at ≤1024px and ≤767px; sizes below are as this screen renders them. Every heading carries its own line-height; h2, h4, h6, title and label also carry their weight. Pair the rest as shown. Add .t-num for tabular figures.

Spacing

tokens.css · --space-*

Tailwind spacing numbers are literal pixels: gap-16 is 16px. Only these steps exist — any other number silently falls back to Tailwind's 4× scale.
